question: Should OpenClaw adopt, publish, and support LLMRouter as an official external provider with its own onboarding choice, environment variable, and CLI flag?
rationale: The plugin architecture supports this integration, but publication under `@openclaw` and the new public setup surface require explicit ownership and product commitment that the contributor or automated review cannot establish.

options.title: Sponsor the official provider
options.body: Approve the official package and setup surface after the replay defect, dependency authorization, and real behavior proof are resolved.

options.title: Keep it community-owned
options.body: Ask for publication as a community provider plugin through ClawHub without adding it to OpenClaw's official external-provider catalog.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the official provider
recommendation.body: Approve the official package and setup surface after the replay defect, dependency authorization, and real behavior proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged Baseten work provides the strongest available history for official external provider adoption and its required validation bar.
